units.translation: not to cross the boundary of the regions
an oracle bidding him to pass through this danger
to the one crossing the law
Of the seats of the gods
you think you dwell in a citadel free from sorrow
where I added περθομέναv [being destroyed] by conjecture.
he is gone, wishing to destroy the land of the Ionians
lamenting your ancient honor being destroyed
and destroy the white hair of my beard
a preposition constructed with three cases: genitive, dative, accusative.
With the genitive: about, concerning, most often with verbs of saying, hearing, asking, thinking.
It is most often postponed to its noun at the end of verses by anastrophe.
Similarly ἀμφὶ τάρβει [around with fear] is said in Ch. 548. The matter is uncertain about

τορὸς γὰρ ὀρθόθριξ φόβος [for piercing, upright-haired fear] (thus corrected from the scholium for φοῖβος ὀρθόθριξ [Phoebus with upright hair]) ἀωρόνυκτον ἀμβόαμα μυχόθεν ἔλακε [uttered an untimely cry from the depths]
where φόβος ἔλακε περὶ φόβῳ [fear cried out around with fear] (from fear) is said ineptly, nor is what Portus conjectured, περιφόβως [fearfully], much better.
where I conjectured περίβαλες [you threw around].
i.e. χεῖρε περιβαλοῦσα [having thrown her arms around].
And with the preposition placed after the verb

for περιεληλάμεναι πύργον [having a tower driven around], i.e. αἷς πύργος περιελήλαται [for whom a tower has been driven around]: about which we spoke above under ἐλαύνω p. 113. Therefore Brunck is right with πέρι [around].
hear what I said about my life
and about men they openly accomplish completely
is it not enough for me to deliberate about these things?
well, we judge that these things should be accomplished for you in every way
I have now been reminded about such things as these
whether I speak about one dead or alive
it belongs to the doer also to deliberate about
I choose you as an interpreter of these portents
we will deliberate about this misfortune
the gods care about whatever they care about
so that he himself might inquire about the man
I never spoke about a man, nor a woman, nor a city
to decide by vote about this matter
having communicated about these things to all the citizens
and struck around my head she was shipwrecked
I revere to speak against you with ancient fear
around with fear, heavy falling in the women's house
of Ocean who winds around the whole earth
the wave around the city – it splashes
which also splashes around the stern of the city
around the wall of the tombs of the Trojan land, beautiful ones hold
a throne dripping with blood around the foot, around the head
whom all the Asian land, having nurtured, laments with longing
Phoebus with upright hair uttered an untimely cry from the depths
fear cried out around with fear
